About me

I’m Aryan Kumar, a student of VFX, animation and multimedia at IIFA Multimedia in Bangalore. I draw, paint and animate in 2D, and model and animate in 3D.

In Photoshop I design posters and typography, composite photos and retouch portraits. I love the small details that make a character feel alive: a head turn, an ear flick, a well-timed blink. I’m learning every day and building my portfolio one artwork at a time.

Maya artwork

3D modelling of buildings and props. Notes on how each piece was made are below. Tap one to view it larger.

Medieval house: perspective view

A timber-framed medieval house with a tiled roof, chimney, small side roof, arched door and barred windows. This angle shows the whole shape and the curved roof edge.

Skills: Polygon modelling, roof tile modelling, timber framing, modular building parts
Medieval house: front view

Front view showing the rows of roof tiles, the timber beams with cross braces, and the windows on both floors.

Skills: Edge loops and detail, repeating tiles, clean beam layout, symmetry
Medieval house: side view

Side view showing the pointed roof, chimney, corner posts and the arched doorway on the ground floor.

Skills: Proportions, arch modelling, roof shape, orthographic checking
